recognize_zh: 箭頭所指為一顆大細胞，核圓至卵圓、染色質細緻呈網狀且著色淡，細胞質豐富、淡藍灰色、邊界模糊並含少量藍色顆粒碎屑，為骨髓巨噬細胞；周圍為各期顆粒球前驅細胞。
features: Large cell with abundant, pale blue-gray cytoplasm and indistinct borders
Round to oval nucleus with delicate, lacy, weakly stained chromatin; no prominent nucleolus
Scattered small blue granules and debris in the cytoplasm
Closely apposed small cell with dark condensed nucleus (erythroblast or lymphocyte)
Background granulocytic precursors (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band neutrophil) and an eosinophilic precursor
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows maturing granulocytic precursors. The arrowed cell is a macrophage with a round to oval nucleus, delicate lacy pale chromatin, and abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with indistinct borders containing a few small blue granules and debris. No phagocytosed intact cells, organisms, or storage material are seen. Findings are consistent with a normal bone marrow macrophage.

ddx.vs: Monocytes are smaller with folded nuclei, gray cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules, and well-defined borders.
Plasma cells have an eccentric nucleus with clock-face chromatin, deep blue cytoplasm, and a perinuclear hof.
Osteoblasts have an eccentric nucleus, deep blue cytoplasm with a hof separated from the nucleus, and occur in clusters.
Hemophagocytes contain engulfed intact red cells, platelets, or nucleated cells.
